# Gas jet flames
DUMMY - NOT REAL DATA. DUMMY-C studied laminar methane jet diffusion flames issuing from a round nozzle into still air.
# Flame length
DUMMY - NOT REAL DATA. Flame length grew with fuel flow rate and the flames were longer and wider than in normal gravity.
# Radiation
DUMMY - NOT REAL DATA. Radiometers measured radiant heat loss, which was a larger share of the heat release for the slow, wide flames.
# Extinction
DUMMY - NOT REAL DATA. Lowering the nitrogen-diluted fuel stream below a threshold led to flame extinction at the tip first.
